title: Garudan
desc: The loyal shadow of two childhood friends, Sokkan, grapples with allegiance and betrayal after a temple's riches comes between all of them.

title: Hitler
desc: Selva's move to Chennai for work leads to unexpected involvement in crime. As the city falls into disarray, a dishonest politician manoeuvres for control.

title: Pokkiri
desc: Thamizh, an undercover officer posing as a hitman, falls for Shruthi, who disapproves of his violent lifestyle. Their growing bond faces risks from his hidden mission.

title: Kingdom of the Dinosaurs
desc: A small group of survivors manage to take shelter in a bunker during World War III in 2030. Two years later, they step out looking for new supplies, but they find dinosaurs roaming around.

title: U-Turn
desc: Rachana, an intern at a newspaper, investigates accidents occurring on a flyover with the help of a crime reporter. However, the situation changes when she is accused of murder.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Thalaivaa
desc: Vishwa runs a small business in Sydney, unaware that his father is a gangster in Mumbai. When his father is killed by a rival, Vishwa takes over his crime syndicate with revenge on his mind.
